"\"Generate a top-down, 2D grid-based cozy farming RPG modeled strictly after Stardew Valley, utilizing a 16x16 pixel art aesthetic and standard mobile touch controls. Implement the following core systems simultaneously to ensure a deep simulation loop:
• 1. Grid @COMMENT_BODY@ Tool Tile Engine: Create an explicit 16x16 tile grid map. Program conditional logic for tile states: Un-tilled Grass -> Tilled Dirt (via Hoe) -> Watered Tilled Dirt (via Watering Can). Trees, large rocks, and weeds must spawn randomly on un-tilled tiles, requiring an Axe or Pickaxe to clear. Tools do not occupy inventory space or have quantities; they are infinite but cost energy.
• 2. Core Time @COMMENT_BODY@ 4-Season Clock: Build a calendar system where 1 second of real-world time equals 1 minute of in-game time. A full day lasts from 6:00 AM to 2:00 AM (20 real-world minutes). If the clock hits 2:00 AM, the player faints, waking up the next day with half energy. Group days into 28-day seasons (Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter). Crops must immediately die if the season changes.
• 3. Interactive Multi-Stage Botany: Program an array of distinct crops (e.g., Parsnips, Tomatos, Pumpkins) with custom data arrays: [GrowthDays, Season, BuyPrice, SellPrice, IsTrellis]. Crops only advance one growth day at the 6:00 AM day-reset if, and only if, their specific tile state is set to 'Watered'. Watered tiles reset to 'Dry' every morning.
• 4. Stardew HUD @COMMENT_BODY@ Energy Budget: Display a persistent UI showing Gold, Date/Season, Time, a 10-slot bottom-anchored hotbar, and an Energy Bar (Max 270). Every swing of a tool reduces energy by 2. If Energy hits 0, trigger an 'Exhausted' debuff status which cuts player movement speed in half.
• 5. Persistent Inventory @COMMENT_BODY@ Economy: Create a dynamic inventory array. Pressing an on-screen backpack button pauses the game and expands the 10-slot hotbar into a full 30-slot grid with a trash icon for deleting items. Place a physical Shipping Bin near the player's farmhouse; dropping items into it logs their sell value, granting the player the accumulated Gold at the morning day-transition screen.\"*
"
